design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Tables: hairline rules, left-aligned headers, numbers right-aligned. No vertical rules.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif size, italic, with a thin rule above and below, centred or left-aligned with indent.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint at 5% of accent colour, serif body text.
